sentence: This project studies why breeding clown anemonefish tolerate non-breeders in their social groups.
This project builds mathematical tools to understand and improve sampling-based methods that compute optimal actions for robots with complex dynamics.
This project studies magnetic reconnection made with multi-petawatt lasers and the electron acceleration that goes with it.
This project supports cybersecurity education and research in areas such as biometrics and wireless network security.
This project studies why lakes, rivers and coldwater fish in northern Mongolia are holding up well in warming waters.
This project studies how the Dark-eyed Junco changes its physiology with temperature, and how this links to its genetics and survival.
This project builds computer-based statistical methods for drawing conclusions from time series and other dependent data.
This project runs a conference forum where research on computing, bioinformatics and health is discussed and critiqued.
This project studies whether cyclone flooding in Hawai‘i helps bacteria that can cause lung disease to appear and spread.
This project designs an automatic system that protects privacy when people share images on social networks.
This project improves and tests a method that finds cancer DNA in blood by blocking normal DNA from replicating.
This project studies how the parasitic plant Cuscuta grows on many different host species, using its DNA and gene expression.
This project builds tools that let quantum computers work with classical supercomputing and artificial intelligence to predict complicated flows.
This project builds an open platform with datasets and tools that help researchers design analog circuits using AI.
This project builds courses, a lab and research projects that link artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
This project builds an encryption method based on lattices and works on hard problems in number theory.
This project builds mathematical tools that help machine learning learn from limited data by using structure such as symmetry.
This project designs and tests technologies that help teens cope with online risks and stay safe online.
This project studies the neural circuitry that makes mice feed more during pregnancy.
